name: URTC-FLASHER
build: Standalone Python desktop tool. pip install -r requirements.txt; Qt Quick CAN-OTA deck is started with --qtquick.
notes: Real GUI flashing tool (CAN-OTA + full-chip SWD/JTAG). Qt Quick (`--qtquick`) is a second front end over the same transport, validation and signed flashing code: CAN-OTA update of the main board, read-only SWD/JTAG discovery, Board Snapshot, the 4 device-configuration writes and full-chip SWD/JTAG programming. It does not have everything the Tkinter window has (no expansion-slave target, no already-in-bootloader option, no F-RAM erase, no downgrade authorisation, no CAN backup, no GitHub download, fixed 500 kbit/s bitrate, no bus-activity check). Tkinter remains the default interface. flasher_protocol.py's deadline/duration math uses time.monotonic() throughout, not the civil clock, so an NTP sync or manual clock change mid-flash can never shorten or lengthen a real timeout.
